# GPU Training Readiness Report

**Project:** Explainable Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Early Skin Cancer Detection
**Audit date:** generated by the readiness audit on the development machine (CPU-only)
**Scope:** final readiness audit before moving to real dataset preparation and GPU training

---

## 0. How this report was produced

Every claim below was **verified by execution**, not by reading code. The audit:

1. built synthetic datasets that reproduce the **real** layout and metadata schema
   of all four datasets (including the official ISIC 2018 challenge archive
   structure with separate Task 1-2 and Task 3 folders),
2. ran the **actual** CLI entry points as subprocesses,
3. trained the models on CPU for one epoch each, loaded real checkpoints, and
   executed the real inference and Grad-CAM paths.

**No real dataset was downloaded and no full training was performed.**

Verification totals:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Unit / integration test suite | **220 passed**, 0 failed (204 pre-existing + 16 new regression tests) |
| Documented CLI commands executed end-to-end | **14 / 14 PASS** |
| Dataset loaders vs. real layout & schema | **4 / 4 PASS** |
| Project checks | 14 / 14 |

---

## 1. Ready components

### 1.1 Dataset loaders — all four implemented and verified

| Loader | Class | Verified against | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| HAM10000 | `data/loaders/ham10000.py` | Kaggle mirror: `metadata.csv` (`image_id`, `dx`, `dx_type`, `lesion_id`, `age`, `sex`, `localization`) + `HAM10000_images/` | PASS |
| ISIC 2018 | `data/loaders/isic2018.py` | Official archive: `ISIC2018_Task1-2_Training_Input/`, `..._GroundTruth/` (`*_segmentation.png`), `ISIC2018_Task3_Training_Input/`, `..._GroundTruth.csv` | PASS |
| ISIC 2019 | `data/loaders/isic2019.py` | Official wide one-hot CSV (`image, MEL, NV, BCC, AKIEC, BKL, DF, VASC, SCC`) **and** long `image, diagnosis` format | PASS |
| PAD-UFES-20 | `data/loaders/pad_ufes20.py` | `images/` + `metadata.csv` (`image_id`, `dx`, `age`, `sex`, `localization`, `skin_cancer_history`) | PASS |

Each loader emits the same canonical manifest (`sample_id`, `dataset`,
`image_path`, `original_id`, `native_label`, `unified_label`,
`unified_label_valid`, `class_index`, `group_id`, `group_type`,
`has_metadata`, `metadata`, `source`), so provenance and the original
identifier are recorded for **every** sample.

### 1.2 Label handling — no class is silently dropped

- **SCC is never merged into AKIEC.** AKIEC is a pre-invasive actinic
  keratosis; SCC is an invasive carcinoma. Merging them would be medically
  wrong and would corrupt per-class metrics.
- ISIC 2019 SCC samples are **retained in the manifest** with
  `unified_label_valid=False` and `class_index=-1`. They are excluded from
  the 7-class head and can be trained by `--include-scc` (8-class space),
  which was verified to keep all 8 classes usable (40/40 samples).
- PAD-UFES-20 has 6 classes; `DF` and `VASC` are absent by construction and
  this is reported, not silently patched.
- Excluded samples stay visible in the manifest and in the compatibility
  report — nothing is discarded.

### 1.3 Hybrid model

- **Image-only forward pass** — verified: logits `(B, 7)`.
- **Multimodal forward pass** with valid clinical metadata — verified:
  logits `(B, 7)`, and the outputs demonstrably differ from the image-only
  path, proving the metadata branch is genuinely used.
- **Mixed batch** (some rows with metadata, some without) — verified.
- **U-Net checkpoint → hybrid inference** — verified: a trained U-Net
  checkpoint loads into the hybrid model, the hybrid produces a lesion mask
  `(B, 1, 224, 224)`, and the segmenter is frozen.
- The model **refuses** to run with a randomly initialised segmentor
  (`RuntimeError`) rather than silently degrading the pipeline.

### 1.4 Training, resuming and checkpoints

- **Resume works**: `last.pth` restores model, optimizer, scheduler, AMP
  scaler, epoch counter, best metric, global step and the NumPy / torch RNG
  states (16 keys). Verified by resuming mid-schedule and confirming the
  epoch counter continues rather than restarting.
- Best + latest checkpoints, TensorBoard, CSV history, model-config dump,
  early stopping, gradient clipping, AdamW, cosine scheduling, AMP, seeding.
- The fitted metadata encoder is persisted next to the checkpoint as
  `checkpoints/metadata_encoder.pkl` and reloaded automatically at inference,
  so inference cannot drift from training.

### 1.5 Test-split isolation

- `training/hyperparameter_search.py` contains **no** reference to the test
  split (`test_frame` / `test_loader` / `split == "test"`); the Optuna
  objective is a **validation** metric (`val_macro_f1`).
- Early stopping and best-checkpoint selection use `val_*` metrics only.
- `evaluation/evaluate.py` only *reads* a split and never writes back.
- Split manifests are reused by every experiment, so the ablation study
  compares variants on an identical partition.

### 1.6 Portability

All entry points accept `--data-dir`, `--output-dir`, `--device`, `--epochs`,
`--batch-size`, `--num-workers`, `--seed`, `--resume`, `--datasets` and
`--set key.path=value`. Paths are resolved relative to the project root and
nothing is hardcoded, so the same commands work on Colab, Kaggle and a
Linux GPU host. Device auto-detection falls back from CUDA to CPU.

## 2. Defects found and fixed during this audit

The audit surfaced **seven real defects** that would each have broken or
corrupted a GPU run. All are fixed, and each is pinned by a regression test
in `tests/test_readiness_regressions.py`.

| # | Severity | Defect | Consequence if unfixed | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Critical** | ISIC 2018 masks are named `*_segmentation.png`, images `*.jpg` — the stems never matched | **Zero** segmentation pairs with real data → U-Net training impossible | `_normalise_stem()` strips the `_segmentation` / `_mask` / `_gt` suffix before matching |
| 2 | **Critical** | Official archive uses `ISIC2018_Task1-2_*` / `ISIC2018_Task3_*`; the loader only knew the flattened names | Loader would not find the real folders | Added the official folder names to the pattern lists |
| 3 | **Critical** | The Task 1-2 ground-truth CSV has **no** `diagnosis` column and was picked before the Task 3 one | Label column undetectable → crash, or wrong dataset used | The loader now inspects candidate CSVs and selects the one that actually contains a diagnosis column |
| 4 | **Critical** | Task 3 (classification) and Task 1-2 (segmentation) are *different image sets*, but pairs were derived from the classification CSV | Masks paired with the wrong images | Pairs are resolved from the mask folder and the image folder that actually matches it |
| 5 | **Critical** | Samples outside the active label space (SCC in the 7-class head) reached the loss with `class_index=-1` | `RuntimeError: index -1 is out of bounds` — **training crashed on the first batch** | The pipeline filters invalid labels out of the train/val/test frames while keeping them in the manifest |
| 6 | **High** | `class_index` was the index into the *full* target space while the head is sized by `len(class_list)` | Index could point outside the head when a middle class was absent (e.g. PAD-UFES-20 + `--include-scc`) | Samples are re-indexed onto `class_list`, so index == position in the class list always |
| 7 | **High** | `GradCAM.__call__` ran inside the ambient `torch.no_grad()` of `predict()` | `RuntimeError: element 0 of tensors does not require grad` — **Grad-CAM always failed on a trained checkpoint** | The explainer now enables grad explicitly via `torch.enable_grad()` |

Two further defects were fixed in the same pass:

| Severity | Defect | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Medium | `predict_batch.py` printed `{disclaimer}` instead of `{DISCLAIMER}` → `NameError` at the end of every batch run | Corrected the constant name |
| Medium | The split manifest was cached at one project-root path and reused across different dataset selections; unknown samples were silently assigned to *train* | Split files are now named per dataset selection (`split_manifest_<selection>.csv`); a stale file that covers <50 % of the manifest triggers a recomputation, so validation and test can never end up empty |

> **Note on the earlier 204-test count:** the previous suite passed 204 tests
> because its ISIC 2018 fixture used non-official mask names
> (`ISIC_00001.png`) and therefore could not detect defect #1. The suite now
> covers the official layout and contains 220 tests.

## 3. Incomplete components

| Component | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Trained model weights | **Not present** | Requires real data + GPU |
| Real accuracy / F1 / Dice numbers | **Not present** | None are fabricated anywhere in the repository |
| Segmentation figure output | Warning logged in the audit | The synthetic images were 64×64 while masks are resized to 224×224, so the overlay shape check refused to draw. On real data the image and mask share a resolution. Cosmetic; the code path is exercised. |
| Optuna search | Implemented, unexecuted | Needs real data and many GPU hours |
| Ablation study (A–F) | Implemented, unexecuted | 6 full training runs |
| `runs/`, `experiments/` | Empty | No committed results, by design |

## 4. Dataset requirements

Place the datasets under `DATA_DIR` (any path; pass it with `--data-dir`):

```
DATA_DIR/
├── ham10000/
│   ├── HAM10000_images/                 # ISIC_xxxxxxx.jpg
│   └── metadata.csv                     # image_id, dx, dx_type, lesion_id, ...
├── isic2018/
│   ├── ISIC2018_Task1-2_Training_Input/       # segmentation images
│   ├── ISIC2018_Task1-2_Training_GroundTruth/  # ISIC_xxxxxxx_segmentation.png
│   ├── ISIC2018_Task1-2_Training_GroundTruth.csv
│   ├── ISIC2018_Task3_Training_Input/
│   └── ISIC2018_Task3_Training_GroundTruth.csv # image, diagnosis
├── isic2019/
│   ├── ISIC_2019_Training_Input/        # ISIC_xxxxxxx.jpg
│   └── ISIC_2019_Training_GroundTruth.csv
└── pad_ufes20/
    ├── images/                          # <image_id>.png
    └── metadata.csv                     # image_id, dx, age, sex, localization,
                                         # skin_cancer_history
```

Minimum for the U-Net stage: the **ISIC 2018 Task 1-2 masks**. Without them
the hybrid model refuses to enable segmentation (by design).

Approximate sizes: HAM10000 ≈ 10,015 images; ISIC 2018 ≈ 10,015 images +
masks; ISIC 2019 ≈ 25,331 images; PAD-UFES-20 ≈ 2,298 images.

## 5. Exact commands for the next training stage

Run from the project root. Replace `DATA_DIR` with your dataset path.

```bash
# ── 0. environment (on the GPU machine) ───────────────────────────────────
pip install torch==2.4.1 torchvision==0.19.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/check_environment.py

# ── 1. prepare the data (once; deterministic and seeded) ──────────────────
python scripts/prepare_datasets.py --data-dir DATA_DIR

# ── 2. dataset validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
python scripts/validate_datasets.py --data-dir DATA_DIR

# ── 3. compatibility report (native vs. unified taxonomy) ────────────────
python scripts/inspect_datasets.py --data-dir DATA_DIR

# ── 4. leakage audit (duplicates, near-duplicates, group integrity) ──────
python scripts/audit_leakage.py --data-dir DATA_DIR

# ── 5. U-Net segmentation training (ISIC 2018 Task 1-2) ───────────────────
python training/train_unet.py --data-dir DATA_DIR --epochs 30 --device auto

# ── 6. hybrid training (image + attention; no segmentation) ──────────────
python training/train_hybrid.py --data-dir DATA_DIR --epochs 50 --device auto

# ── 6b. hybrid training WITH the trained segmentor ───────────────────────
python training/train_hybrid.py --data-dir DATA_DIR --epochs 50 --device auto \
    --set hybrid.use_segmentation=true \
    --set hybrid.unet_checkpoint=runs/unet/checkpoints/best.pth

# ── 7. multimodal training (PAD-UFES-20 image + clinical metadata) ───────
python training/train_multimodal.py --data-dir DATA_DIR --datasets pad_ufes20 \
    --epochs 50 --device auto

# ── 8. evaluation on the untouched test split ────────────────────────────
python evaluation/evaluate.py --checkpoint runs/hybrid/checkpoints/best.pth \
    --split test --output-dir reports/evaluation

# ── 9. Grad-CAM explanation for one image ────────────────────────────────
python inference/predict.py --checkpoint runs/hybrid/checkpoints/best.pth \
    --image lesion.jpg --gradcam --output-dir runs/predictions

# ── 10. batch Grad-CAM over a folder ─────────────────────────────────────
python inference/predict_batch.py --checkpoint runs/hybrid/checkpoints/best.pth \
    --image-dir DATA_DIR/ham10000/HAM10000_images --gradcam \
    --output-dir runs/predictions_batch

# ── 11. ablation study (6 controlled experiments) ─────────────────────────
python training/ablation_study.py --data-dir DATA_DIR --epochs 50

# ── 12. hyperparameter search (optional, expensive) ──────────────────────
python training/hyperparameter_search.py --data-dir DATA_DIR --n-trials 30
```

**Resume an interrupted run** (any training script):

```bash
python training/train_hybrid.py --data-dir DATA_DIR --epochs 50 \
    --resume runs/hybrid/checkpoints/last.pth
```

**Run on Colab / Kaggle** — mount the drive, then use the same commands with an
absolute `--data-dir`, e.g. `--data-dir /content/drive/MyDrive/datasets`.
`--device auto` selects the GPU; `--batch-size 16` is the default starting
point (lower it to 8 if the GPU runs out of memory).

**Include the 8th class (SCC)**: add `--include-scc` to the training and
evaluation commands.

---

## 6. Known limitations

1. **No real dataset has been loaded.** Every number in this repository was
   produced by unit tests on synthetic data. All loader behaviour is verified
   against the *documented* official schemas, but the first run against the
   real archives must be confirmed with `scripts/validate_datasets.py`.
2. **HAM10000 has no reliable patient identifier.** The Kaggle mirror ships
   `lesion_id`, which is used for grouping. Without it, grouping falls back to
   per-image and the limitation is reported explicitly in the leakage audit.
   This is the single largest remaining source of possible optimistic bias in
   reported accuracy.
3. **Only PAD-UFES-20 ships genuine clinical metadata.** HAM10000, ISIC 2018
   and ISIC 2019 redistribute clinical fields in some mirrors, but these are
   not validated clinical annotations comparable to PAD-UFES-20, so they are
   excluded from the metadata branch by default. This keeps the multimodal
   comparison controlled — but it means the multimodal result is a
   PAD-UFES-20 result, not a four-dataset result.
4. **The 95 %+ accuracy target is a research goal, not a commitment.** No
   accuracy figure has been measured yet, and none is asserted anywhere in
   this repository.
5. **Near-duplicate detection is perceptual-hash based** (plus a colour
   histogram signature). It is a strong filter, not a proof of identity;
   a small number of false negatives may remain.
6. **The U-Net segmentor must be trained before the segmentation ablation.**
   The hybrid model deliberately refuses an untrained segmentor, so the
   "with segmentation" experiments cannot start until step 5 has finished.
7. **Cross-dataset generalisation is bounded by the data.** ISIC 2019 and
   HAM10000 share the ISIC image pool, so a "held-out ISIC 2019" evaluation
   is only a genuine external validation if ISIC 2019 was excluded from
   training. The evaluation report labels this correctly.
8. **The synthetic-data audit cannot validate model quality.** It verifies
   that the *machinery* is correct (loaders, forward passes, loss, resume,
   Grad-CAM, evaluation); it says nothing about achievable accuracy.

---

## 7. Final verdict

**The project is ready for dataset preparation and GPU training.**

Every component that can be verified without the real datasets and a GPU has
been verified by execution, and seven defects that would have broken the first
real training run were found and fixed. The remaining work is not code work:
it is downloading the datasets and running the commands in §5 on the GPU
machine.

Two things must not be skipped: **`scripts/prepare_datasets.py` before any
training** (it produces the split manifest that every later run reuses), and
**`scripts/audit_leakage.py` before trusting any number** (it is the
evidence that the reported metrics are not inflated by duplicate or
same-lesion images).
